additional_info.subject: RE: ID0469488-DC/Si-D/IL- [MP / P4 170000453] Failure to read power meter CRM:03289000063
additional_info.body:
Hello Orel,
I hope you are doing well.
Sorry that in the last issue I didn´t make CC to you.
But, I was instructed that we should reply the case originator only. We have to handle chargers all over the world. And if we need to find out RC for each region its also lots of time to find out from the email list.
Also Assume that which country has hundreds of chargers ( i.e; FR/ DE/CH...). If we make CC all the cases, sometimes the handover cases may get overlooked.
We only involve the RC when its needed.
Today morning  when I checked all outlet was off. I have tried to do remote troubleshooting 3 times. Now its is in operation except outlet :3. The customer deactivated outlet: 3 on purpose.
Now the second point: to check any previous issue we need specific timeframe. As you know the charger sends hundreds of log files per minutes. Its not possible to find out previous errors without specific time frame.
As the customer asked to close the case. I should close the case. If you have any further issue, please knock me in MS teams of write me an email. Or, can create a new ticket.
AS per rule every case should be in different case ID.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com
